items.text: Patriots downgraded WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) to OUT for Sunday vs Dolphins. Confirmed by multiple reports after earlier Q tag and limited/DNP practices.
items.why: Knee flare-up added to ankle issue; no practice Thu/Fri; official downgrade.
items.implication: Removes WR1 upside; look to other NE pass-catchers or sit if rostered.
items.opportunity: None direct; opens volume for remaining WRs if any viable.

items.text: Patriots also ruled RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness) OUT vs Dolphins after DNP practices and Q listing.
items.why: Illness leading to missed practices; official OUT.
items.implication: Rhamondre Stevenson likely sees expanded/bellcow role.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for Stevenson; monitor handcuff value.

items.text: ETR Sunday injury board: OUT includes Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate, RJ Harvey, DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks, Terry McLaurin; Q includes Breece Hall, Jaylen Waddle, DJ Moore, George Pickens, AJ Brown/Henderson (pre-downgrade); IN Lamar Jackson, Saquon Barkley, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, Ladd McConkey, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Comprehensive final-ish board with practice/designation tracking.
items.implication: Key status locks for lineup decisions; fallout in projs.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUTs (e.g. more targets without Harvey/Egbuka/Smith); reverse if unexpected IN.

items.text: Colts now open to trading star RB Jonathan Taylor; talks active/ongoing with multiple teams (interest from DEN, GB, MIN, NYG, SEA). Seeking premium haul similar to CMC deal. Taylor wants to stay but can't control.
items.why: Sources confirm open/willing after other trades; owner talk with player; offers received/rejected.
items.implication: Monitor deadline (Nov 10); value spike if moved to contender; short-term uncertainty.
items.opportunity: No immediate role change but ROS landing spot critical.

items.text: Levitan notes: Taken Egbuka (concussion/foot), Tate (shoulder), Spears (knee), AJ Brown (knee) OUT in projs. RJ Harvey role unique so no clean replacement but 3-6 extra targets available (Waddle also Q). Breece Hall cryptic tweets + another Q after near-play last week. Shocked Barkley not on final report but playing (not 100%). Lamar small rushing docks. Meyers LP-LP-DNP opens possible season-high routes for Travis Hunter given BTJ issues. DJ Moore/Kincaid no FP post-bye.
items.why: Practice trends, unique roles, cryptic signals, historical near-misses.
items.implication: Updated projs reflect fallout; sell/monitor Breece; Hunter opportunity bump; Barkley risk despite IN.
items.opportunity: Extra targets without Harvey; Hunter routes; Stevenson if Henderson out; limited Lamar rush.

items.text: After two-TD outing, try to sell Quinshon Judkins. ETR clip explains why (role hit with Sampson return).
items.why: Season lows in snaps/targets with Dylan Sampson back; prior higher target share without him.
items.implication: Sell-high post-spike; role dilution in passing game.
items.opportunity: Reduced target share (from 13.6% avg without Sampson).

items.text: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route of strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 carries inside-5 and 13 targets in two games since suspension. Efficiency bonus only.
items.why: Inside-5 carries and target volume post-suspension parallel to Jeanty's fantasy viability despite efficiency.
items.implication: Start with confidence; volume king over pure YPC.

items.text: Berry LOVES Zay Flowers @ BUF as WR5; Lamar unlock in potential track-meet Bills-Ravens game.
items.why: Lamar return + soft/high-scoring matchup; Flowers quarterback-proof but prefers Jackson.
items.implication: Strong start; WR1 upside this week.

items.text: Berry HATES Saquon Barkley (RB20 @ WSH), Tony Pollard (RB21 @ CIN), Omarion Hampton (RB34 @ LAR). Usage concerns for Barkley post-news; Pollard underdog spot; Hampton role-seeking.
items.why: Barkley usage/injury management risk; Pollard tough underdog matchup; Hampton limited role.
items.implication: Sit or fade these backs this week.
items.opportunity: Low snap/role confidence despite Barkley IN.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan note Barkley playing but not 100%.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry @ BUF (RB6), Chase Brown vs TEN (RB8), Josh Jacobs vs CAR (RB11); also Breece Hall/Braelon Allen vs LV. Run-stopping defenses weak this week.
items.why: Favorable run matchups; Henry history vs BUF; Brown TD regression; Jacobs volume; Hall/Allen committee upside.
items.implication: Prioritize starts; Jacobs aligns with Levitan usage.

items.text: In 2 games since Caleb Williams return, Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG; leads TE utilization; top-5 finishes both weeks.
items.why: Sustained high target share and production with Williams.

items.text: Brian Thomas Jr. went 87-1282-10 as rookie; now in Konata Mumpfield/Troy Franklin tier of Week 8 projections after 20 games.
items.why: Sustained poor projection tier despite early career production.
items.implication: Fade or lower expectations; not WR1/2 caliber currently.

items.text: Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle (vs KC tough secondary); LOVES Joe Burrow vs TEN (QB2) and Trevor Lawrence vs IND (QB4) in high-scoring spots. Also Flowers LOVE already covered.
items.why: Waddle tough D + Q chest; Burrow/Lawrence volume vs weak pass Ds/high totals.
items.implication: Sit Waddle (also Q/Harvey out); start Burrow/Lawrence confidently.
items.opportunity: Waddle limited; QBs high attempt upside.

items.text: Dylan Sampson first game back from IR: Judkins season lows in snap rate (51.5%) and target share (3%). Without Sampson, Judkins averaged 13.6% targets. Majority touches but passing role hit.
items.implication: Lower ceiling; aligns with Levitan sell.
